item.title: Antelope Reef Could Now Be the Largest Island in the South China Sea
item.description: China’s land reclamation reaches an unprecedented scale.

item.title: Could Iran Disrupt the Gulf Countries’ Desalinated Water Supplies?
item.description: The countries of the Persian Gulf critically rely on desalination systems for their water supplies. The conflict with Iran puts these vital resources at risk. Tehran could attack desalination plants in a bid to widen the war and raise its stakes.

item.title: Iran: Relearning the Importance of Waging a War, Not Just Fighting One
item.description: Lieutenant General James Michael Dubik (U.S. Army, ret) examines the divergence between the United States' warfighting capabilities and war-waging requirements, highlighting three skills critical to waging war.

item.title: How Does Saudi Arabia See the War with Iran?
item.description: Saudi Arabia finds itself in an unprecedented war with Iran. Not surprisingly, Saudi views of this war are complicated.

item.title: CSIS Names Thamar Harrigan Chief of Staff of the Economic Security and Technology Department
item.description: The Center for Strategic and International Studies today announced that Thamar Harrigan has joined the CSIS Economic Security and Technology (EST) Department as chief of staff and director of operations.

item.title: States Weekly Newsletter: March 18, 2026
item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers March 18, 2026.

item.title: Not a Time for Arms Control With North Korea
item.description: The U.S. proposal of arms control, were it to happen, will undo the current structure of deterrence against North Korea’s nuclear threats. It will convince North Korea that its nuclear ambitions have been vindicated as the right course of action and lead it to demand a heavy price.

item.title: SBIR and STTR Reauthorization and the Future of Small Business Innovation
item.description: The United States Senate has passed legislation to reauthorize the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) programs through fiscal year 2031, though challenges remain to catalyze the long-term growth of small businesses.
